📅 本週 AI 新聞回顧 · 2026-09-14 ～ 2026-09-19
1. Dario Amodei and Other AI Leaders Want to 'Pace the Frontier' — But How?政策
Dario Amodei 等AI領袖想「放慢前沿腳步」，但要怎麼做？
A week after an Anthropic researcher's doomsday warning rattled the AI world, CEO Dario Amodei outlined a plan to "pace the frontier" of AI development, leaning on independent safety evaluators and coordination between labs in democratic countries. Critics question how such voluntary coordination could actually be enforced.
在Anthropic研究員的末日警告震撼業界一週後，執行長Dario Amodei提出「放慢前沿」計畫，主張由獨立安全評估機構與民主國家的AI實驗室協調合作。外界質疑這種自願性協調究竟該如何落實。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
2. Researchers Used Anthropic's Claude to Hack Into OpenAI資安
資安研究人員用 Claude 成功駭入 OpenAI
Security researchers used Claude to exploit vulnerabilities in OpenAI's systems, taking over employee accounts and gaining access to an internal code repository before responsibly reporting the flaws. The team said the break-in took less than 72 hours.
資安研究人員利用Anthropic的Claude找出OpenAI系統漏洞，取得員工帳號並存取內部程式碼庫，隨後負責任地通報漏洞。研究團隊表示整個入侵過程不到72小時。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
3. AI Hallucination of Chinese Nuclear Components Almost Triggered a US Military Attack資安
AI 幻覺誤判中國核子零件，差點引爆美軍攻擊行動
A large language model reportedly hallucinated details about Chinese arms shipments, nearly leading the US military to board a Chinese ship. Experts warn service members need to understand the uncertainty inherent to LLM outputs before acting on them.
一套大型語言模型疑似虛構了中國軍火運輸的細節，幾乎導致美軍登船攔查一艘中國船隻。專家警告，軍方人員在依據AI輸出採取行動前，必須理解LLM本身存在的不確定性。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
4. OpenAI and Microsoft Knew They Were Starting a 'Doom Loop' for the Web政策
OpenAI 與微軟早知道自己正對網路發動「死亡循環」
Newly unsealed court documents from the New York Times' lawsuit show OpenAI and Microsoft's own internal documentation warned their data scraping was starting a "doom loop" that would damage the web, calling it the "largest theft of labor in human history."
紐約時報對OpenAI與微軟訴訟案中新解密的法庭文件顯示，兩家公司內部文件早已警告，其資料爬取行為正在對網路造成「死亡循環」，甚至將其稱為「人類史上最大規模的勞動竊取」。
The Verge · 原文連結
5. Google's New 'CC' Is an AI Agent That Helps Families Run Their Households產品
Google 推出家庭管家 AI 代理人「CC」
Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting family members share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, and plan meals.
Google將旗下CC AI代理人重新定位為家庭事務協調工具，讓家庭成員共享電子郵件、行程與待辦事項，由AI代為管理行事曆、填表單、列購物清單並規劃餐點。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
6. A New Kind of AI Model From a ChatGPT Inventor Is Thrilling Developers模型
ChatGPT 發明者推出新型 AI 模型，讓開發者驚艷
Jev, a new type of AI model from a ChatGPT co-creator, is showing developers a cheaper and faster path to building software intelligence.
由ChatGPT共同發明者打造的新型AI模型Jev，正向開發者展示一條更便宜、更快速打造軟體智慧的路徑。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. Anthropic Is Operating a Lab That Conducts Biology Experiments研究
Anthropic 正在營運一間進行生物實驗的實驗室
AI leaders have promised that AI is key to curing human disease, even as Anthropic's own researchers warn AI might pose existential risks — now the company is running an actual biology lab to test that promise.
AI業界領袖不斷宣稱AI是治癒人類疾病的關鍵，但Anthropic研究員同時也警告AI可能帶來滅絕級風險；如今該公司實際成立生物實驗室來驗證這項承諾。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
8. Virginia Governor Creates an AI Task Force and Moves to Restrain Data Centers政策
維吉尼亞州長成立 AI 工作小組，並著手限制資料中心擴張
Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger issued an executive order empowering local communities to have a bigger say in data center development and slowing approvals in a state already home to the world's data center capital.
維吉尼亞州長Abigail Spanberger簽署行政命令，賦予地方社區對資料中心開發更大的話語權，並放緩核准速度——該州目前已是全球資料中心密度最高的地區。
The Verge · 原文連結
9. Manus Seeks $4B Valuation in New $500M Fundraise as It Resumes Independent Ops產業
Manus 尋求 40 億美元估值，重啟獨立營運並籌資 5 億美元
Manus, which earlier this year had to break off a merger with Meta, is now in discussions to raise $500 million at a $4 billion valuation as it goes it alone again.
今年稍早才與Meta終止合併案的Manus，如今正洽談以40億美元估值籌募5億美元資金，重新展開獨立營運。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. World Model Companies Are Keeping a Lot of Secrets產業
世界模型新創公司普遍守口如瓶
Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on piles of cash and buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from founders to their own data suppliers — to explain what they're actually building.
世界模型領域的每家公司都坐擁大筆資金與話題熱度，但無論是創辦人還是自家的資料供應商，幾乎沒人願意透露他們實際在打造什麼。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
